title: Screenshot
scope: Shared by all windows. Only the default Local window registers the system shortcut; manual capture remains available when this is off.
shortcutHint: Click the key combination and press a new shortcut to save. Esc cancels. Registration conflicts are shown in the default Local window’s Shortcuts settings.
waiting: Move the pointer to the target screen…
hint: Drag to select · Esc to cancel · Enter to copy

errors.SCREENSHOT_UNAVAILABLE: This window cannot perform the screenshot operation.
errors.SCREENSHOT_SHORTCUT_FAILED: Could not register this shortcut. It may be in use by another application.
errors.SCREENSHOT_BUSY: A screenshot is already in progress.
errors.SCREENSHOT_EXPIRED: This screenshot session has ended. Start a new capture.
errors.SCREENSHOT_IMAGE_INVALID: The screenshot is invalid or exceeds the supported image size.
errors.SCREENSHOT_MONITOR_MISSING: The display is no longer available.
errors.SCREENSHOT_LOAD_FAILED: The screenshot editor did not become ready. Please try again.
errors.SCREENSHOT_WAYLAND_UNSUPPORTED: This region selection mode currently requires X11 on Linux.
errors.generic: The screenshot operation failed. Check screen capture permissions and try again.

manualHint: Select a region on the screen containing the pointer. WSL and SSH windows also capture this computer, not the remote desktop.
